modelDescription: The Fierce Carbon Rival XP 2.0 is built for hardcore hunters who want a full carbon barrel and stock platform without stepping up to a titanium action. Pairing a Dual-Lug Stainless Steel Action with a C3 Match Grade Carbon Barrel and Rival XP 2.0 C3 Carbon Stock, it delivers the same Fierce accuracy standard.
